title: Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar killed by Israeli forces in Rafah
body:
On 16 October 2024, Israeli troops killed Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar in Rafah, southern Gaza. The IDF Spokesperson described the encounter as a chance firefight with Israeli troops. It said soldiers fired on a group of militants on the ground floor of a building in Rafah on Wednesday 16 October, and on the Thursday searched the rubble and found three dead militants, one of whom closely resembled Sinwar.

Sinwar was reported to have died under a collapsed building after it was hit by a tank shell. The Shin Bet, the IDF Spokesperson and Israel Police said they were working to confirm his identity. Dental images were sent to Israel Police laboratories to be compared with records from the time Sinwar was held as a prisoner in Israel, and DNA tests were also carried out. The IDF confirmed his death on 17 October 2024.

Israel described Sinwar as the architect of the 7 October 2023 attack. He had become head of Hamas's political bureau after the assassination of Ismail Haniyeh in Tehran in July 2024.
